scripts.dev: concurrently -n coordinator,downstream,client -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w downstream" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build:dotnet: node scripts/dotnet.mjs restore coordinator-dotnet --locked-mode && node scripts/dotnet.mjs build coordinator-dotnet -c Release --no-restore
scripts.build:group: npm run build && npm run build:dotnet
scripts.verify:group: npm run verify && npm run build:dotnet && npm run smoke:dotnet && npm run smoke:dotnet:sql && npm run smoke:grpc:dotnet && npm run audit:dotnet
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && npm run typecheck:browser
scripts.package: git archive --format=zip --prefix=relaylab/ -o relaylab-submission.zip HEAD && unzip -l relaylab-submission.zip | tail -1
scripts.verify: npm test && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run smoke && npm run smoke:reviews && npm run smoke:grpc && npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high
scripts.test:browser: cross-env VITE_API_BASE_URL= npm run build:group && playwright test
